title: Precision GPU Studio: smooth 3D and soft shadows
changes: Smooth the exact GenyCaster SVG solid with a 1664px, 16-bit packed distance atlas and analytically sampled vector tangent normals to eliminate banded sidewalls.
Improve light and dark studio lighting with a soft projected logo shadow, floor bounce, and better metallic contrast while preserving portable Qt GPU rendering.
Move the accessible reset, rotation and zoom controls to the lower brand panel, above the copyright and version information.
